verdict_reason: The sign-in round trip correctly moves to the new address type page and its rationale comments moved to docs/security.md, but its URL assertion repeats an unescaped anchoring rule the list page now owns.

todos.issue: Line 15 anchors the address type URL inline with new RegExp(`${insPages.addressBookAddressType.expectedUrl}$`), unescaped, while this PR gives the list page one owner for the same rule (list-page.ts:18 listUrl, escaped with escapeRegex). The same inline form is repeated for the address type page in address-book-add-type.spec.ts:154, e2e address-book-auth.spec.ts:18 and address-book-add-form.spec.ts:48, so 'the page's URL with no query' now has two mechanisms.
todos.fix: Must: one helper owns 'this page's URL, anchored and escaped' for the address type page (and the add page), and every spec asserting that URL calls it. One way: lift listUrl into opensAtExpectedUrl as a shared getter (for example urlWithNoQuery) and use it here and in the three e2e specs.
